key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:2:023E
name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Walks a table of pointer and value pairs, allocating a fixed-size node for each entry through a memory allocation call and storing the looked-up value in it. Consecutive nodes are linked together and the head of the new list is returned.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:10:0034
name: call_library_vector_198
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the function at a fixed negative offset from it, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:4:0000
name: match_global_string_prefix
description: Compares a global text string against a buffer from its start and advances the buffer pointer while the bytes match. When a fixed byte in the buffer equals a particular character, it first tries a full match from the start and, on success, writes a five-byte dot and space pad into the buffer.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:4:0028
name: write_dot_space_padding
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into five consecutive bytes of the buffer addressed by the address register.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:4:0048
name: skip_matching_global_prefix
description: Advances the buffer pointer one byte at a time while its bytes equal the global text, stopping when the global text reaches its terminator.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:4:0058
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware use, so it does no work.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:6:0000
name: call_with_stack_argument_pointer
description: Passes its two parameters on to another routine together with a pointer to a fixed offset in the caller's stack frame, then returns.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:5:0000
name: measure_stack_string_and_forward
description: Calls a function through a global library base, then counts the characters of a stack-held string up to its terminator. If the string is non-empty it passes the string, its length and the parameter on to another routine.

key: Tunnels of Armageddon/Tunnels of Armageddon.adf:loadwb:5:004C
name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register into the memory location addressed by the address register, then returns.

name: setup_copper_and_clear_memory
description: Opens a library through the exec base, copies a table of words into a block of memory and clears a 1920-byte region. It then writes the DMA control and copper list registers, waits for a busy flag to clear, and closes the library.

name: service_pending_interrupt_flags
description: Tests an interrupt flag bit and, when it is set, checks a second interrupt request bit and calls up to three helper routines. It then clears the top bit of its status word.

key: runtime segment $050000-$050380:0:014A
name: write_next_table_entry
description: Reads the byte at the current table pointer, wrapping the pointer back to a base address when its value is negative. It stores a word built from that byte in the high half plus a fixed constant, then advances the pointer by four.

name: build_frame_copper_list
description: Computes per-frame display geometry from state fields and fills a copper-style list of word pairs in memory. It writes rows of entries in groups, inserts end-of-list terminators, and advances a phase counter in the state.

name: program_hardware_copy_block
description: Waits until a hardware busy bit clears, then writes control words and address pointers into hardware registers. It advances a rotating pointer through a byte table, looks up the next value in a grid of entries and copies seven strided bytes into a target area.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0008
name: initialise_game_resources_and_display
description: Calls memory allocation and availability routines through the exec base, sets up display and graphics resources through helper calls and draws several rows of items in a loop. A memory-size check selects which setup branch runs.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0404
name: call_fixed_entry_then_helper
description: Calls a routine at a fixed address, then calls a second routine with no arguments.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0416
name: store_flag_and_run_setup_steps
description: Stores its parameter in a state field, calls five helper routines, and runs further helpers chosen by the parameter and a state flag. It finishes by calling a library function through the global base.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0496
name: wrap_block_call_with_library_calls
description: Calls a library function, then a helper routine with a width taken from a state field and a value from the state, and finally calls the library function again.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0510
name: allocate_and_copy_table
description: Calls a helper to get a count, then allocates a memory block through the library base and stores its address in the state. It copies bytes from a fixed source table into the block, for the number of bytes the count gives.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0568
name: free_block_at_fixed_argument
description: Calls a helper with a fixed argument, then releases a memory block through the library base free function.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0592
name: free_nonnull_entries_from_list
description: Walks a table of pointers from its last entry back to the first and, for each non-null entry, calls the library free function through the global base.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:05E0
name: allocate_buffer_with_fallback
description: Allocates a memory block through the library base and stores its address in the state, calling a helper when the result is zero. It then calls two helpers, sets a state flag when the second returns non-zero, and otherwise calls a further helper when the size exceeds a limit.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0638
name: run_timed_draw_frame_loop
description: Runs a loop of up to 108 frames, each time waiting on a library timing value, drawing rows through helper routines and swapping two buffers of six pointers. It stops early when a helper returns non-zero and finishes by calling two library functions.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:095E
name: allocate_buffer_with_fallback
description: Allocates a memory block through the library base and stores its address in the state, calling a helper when the result is zero. It then calls two helpers, sets a state flag when the second returns non-zero, and otherwise calls a further helper when the size exceeds a limit.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:09B4
name: run_timed_draw_frame_loop
description: Runs a loop of up to 50 frames, each time waiting on a library timing value, drawing rows through helper routines and swapping two buffers of six pointers. It stops early when a helper returns non-zero and finishes by calling two library functions.

key: runtime segment $C02750-$C03A90:0:0CAE
name: build_and_draw_scene_tables
description: Fills two tables of values from strides and a state flag, then loops over 22 entries, drawing a set of items for each and swapping buffer pointers. It finishes with library calls and a final drawn item.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:run:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When the buffer pointer passed in is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in the data block into that buffer. It then calls through a function pointer held in a register and returns.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:0000
name: unpack_entries_and_save_state
description: Program entry that saves the register state onto the stack, then walks a list of entries. For each non-zero entry it calls a helper and adds a rotated value into a memory block. It finally copies thirteen words of code into a low-memory area and records that address.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:00F4
name: unpack_rotated_blocks_loop
description: Saves the register state into a frame, then loops over a table of entries that call helpers and add a rotated value into a memory block for each count. It writes the saved register values into the frame before returning.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:09EC
name: delay_loop_countdown
description: Counts a register value down to zero in a tight loop with no other work, serving as a busy-wait delay.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:0B72
name: copy_block_then_zero_range
description: Copies longwords from a source pointer to a destination until the destination reaches a limit, then zeroes longwords up to a second limit. It stores several register values into global variables and returns the stack argument the caller pushed.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:0B90
name: run_state_loop_with_helpers
description: Runs an outer loop that sets several global state values, calls many helper routines and branches on those values. It leaves an inner loop when a state value reaches a count of eight, then repeats.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2EC2
name: loop_until_state_limit
description: Repeatedly sets a global state value and calls helper routines, looping back while the state stays non-negative. It exits when the state reaches a count of eight.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2ED2
name: run_nested_state_loop
description: Runs an outer loop that sets global state values and calls helper routines, with an inner loop that continues while the state is non-negative. It leaves the inner loop when the state reaches a count of eight.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2EDE
name: init_globals_and_countdown_loop
description: Sets a run of global variables, including starting values of 500 and 5, then runs a loop that counts one value down to zero while calling helper routines. It resets the globals afterwards, sets one to 3 and calls three helpers.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2F92
name: reset_globals_and_call_helpers
description: Writes zero to most of a run of global variables, sets one of them to 3, and then calls three helper routines.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2FDE
name: wait_until_global_reaches_four
description: Busy-waits until a global variable is at least four, then resets that variable to zero and returns.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:2FF4
name: poll_flag_bit_with_timeout
description: Sets a global counter to 3500 and scans it downward through a nested delay loop, leaving early when bit seven of the counter is set. Afterwards it busy-waits while bit seven stays set, then returns.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3020
name: wait_while_flag_bit_set
description: Busy-waits while bit seven of a global variable remains set, then returns.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:302E
name: run_countdown_state_machine
description: Sets a countdown state variable to 12 and loops over it, calling helper routines on each pass. A state of two can branch to an early return when a computed value matches one of a few fixed thresholds, and a helper returning non-zero also ends the loop.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3060
name: run_state_sequence_return_status
description: Runs one of two helper sequences depending on a global state value and returns a status. A non-zero state performs a fixed set of helper calls and a loop of 81 passes, while a state of two steps the state upward through helper-calling passes before returning it.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:30B8
name: repeat_five_helpers_while_incrementing
description: Repeats a pass of five helper calls while incrementing a global value, and stops when that value no longer stays above a fixed negative limit.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:30E8
name: run_helper_sequence_when_set
description: When a global value is non-zero, calls four helpers and then runs an 81-pass loop of helper calls, with an extra helper call on one pass. Otherwise it returns without doing any work.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:30F4
name: run_eighty_one_pass_helper_loop
description: Calls four helpers, then runs an 81-pass loop of helper calls with an extra helper call on one pass, and returns.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3146
name: run_state_machine_from_two
description: Sets a state variable to two and loops over state transitions, calling helper routines on each pass. A helper returning non-zero or a state reaching a fixed threshold ends the loop, and a state of two takes an extra branch that can return early.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:316C
name: run_transition_loop_until_negative
description: Loops over a state variable, calling helper routines and a routine that does nothing on each pass. It returns early when a helper reports non-zero, when a state of two steps down through fixed thresholds, or when the state turns negative.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:31DC
name: run_state_loop_with_parameters
description: Loops over a global state value using two register parameters, calling helpers on each pass. It exits when the parameters match fixed values, when the state turns negative, or when a helper returns non-zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:31EC
name: run_state_loop_until_parameter_match
description: Loops over a global state value with register parameters, calling nine helpers and a routine that does nothing across its passes. It exits when the parameters match fixed values, the state turns negative, or a helper returns non-zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3262
name: run_inner_state_loop
description: Runs nested loops over a global state value, calling helpers and stepping the value down or up on each pass. It returns when the value turns negative, a helper reports non-zero, or a state of two is reached.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3274
name: run_nested_state_stepping_loop
description: Runs an outer loop of helper calls around an inner loop that steps a global state value down or up, calling helpers on each pass. It returns when the value turns negative, a helper reports non-zero, or the state reaches zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3296
name: step_state_until_zero
description: Steps a global state value down, then loops calling helpers while stepping it up, and returns when the value turns negative, a helper reports non-zero, or the value reaches zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:32B8
name: run_state_loop_with_empty_stub
description: Loops over a global state value, calling helper routines and a routine that does nothing, stepping the value up or down. It returns when the value turns negative or reaches zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:32F6
name: advance_index_and_lookup_table
description: Increments a global counter, reads a byte from a table at a position taken from bits two to six of the counter, and sets the top bit of the stored result when it is greater than one.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3332
name: emit_global_string_per_character
description: If the global value is zero, replaces it with the character for zero. It then calls a helper and calls another helper for each character of the global text up to its terminator, returning zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:334A
name: emit_global_digit_then_string
description: Adds the character for zero to the global value, calls a helper, then calls another helper for each character of the global text up to its terminator, returning zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:336C
name: emit_fixed_text_after_helper
description: Calls a helper, then calls another helper for each character of a text string at a fixed address up to its terminator, returning zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:337E
name: emit_fixed_text_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers, then calls another helper for each character of a text string at a fixed address up to its terminator, returning zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:33A2
name: run_five_helpers_then_set_flag
description: Calls five helpers, then when the global value is three or five calls two more helpers for each case. It finishes by setting the global to the 16-bit value of all ones.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:340A
name: set_done_flag_after_helpers
description: When the byte passed in a register equals five, calls two helpers. It then calls one more helper and sets the global to the 16-bit value of all ones.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3430
name: emit_fixed_text_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers, then calls another helper for each character of a text string at a fixed address up to its terminator, returning zero.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3454
name: wait_then_halt_if_flag_set
description: If a global value is non-zero, busy-waits until it becomes zero and then enters an endless loop without returning. Otherwise it returns at once.

key: star wars - return of the jedi (1988)(domark)[cr qtx][a]/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi (1988)(Domark)[cr QTX][a].adf:Jedi:0:3460
